title: Add auth token operations

context.summary: Add first-class API and CLI operations for issuing, listing, rotating and revoking bearer tokens.
context.background: Access control exists, but MVP credentials are currently created by seed scripts or direct database writes. A working MVP needs operational token management without manual DB access.

in: Add project-scoped token creation API with permission selection and optional expiration.
Add token listing API that never returns raw token values after creation.
Add token revoke API and token rotation API.
Add CLI commands for token create/list/revoke/rotate.
Ensure token hashes, status, expiration and last-used behavior remain safe.
Update API, CLI and security documentation.
out: Add a web UI for token management.
Replace bearer-token auth with another auth scheme.

acceptance_criteria: API can create a token and returns the raw token exactly once.
API can list token metadata without exposing raw tokens or hashes.
API can revoke a token and revoked tokens receive 401/403 behavior as appropriate.
API can rotate a token while preserving project permissions.
CLI exposes token create/list/revoke/rotate commands with clear errors and exit codes.
Docs describe token lifecycle and safe storage expectations.

manual_checks: Confirm raw token values are not stored or logged.
Confirm seed-based demo token still works unless intentionally replaced.

risks: Token rotation can accidentally invalidate live demo scripts if compatibility is not preserved.
Returning token secrets from list/get endpoints would be a security regression.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to accepted or done.
Branch is committed and merged back into master.
